Apple's book-style iPhone Ultra, expected to be unveiled next week, reportedly uses two UTG layers, with the display sandwiched between them, isolating it from direct contact with the hinge. The UTG layers will be mass produced for Apple's rivals by Samsung, for wide adoption in 2027. ### Sunbird's iMessage for Android App Returns to the Google Play Store.
